Sch. 7 §1(a)(i): 由觀塘區界線至順清街的一段新清水灣道 — from the Sai Kung boundary west to the Shun Ching Street junction (114.2243). The ring takes the whole interchange at the Lee On Road junction (114.2217): the westbound way in drops to it and the eastbound return climbs back from it, both west of Shun Ching Street, and without them §1(a)(iv) would end at a road the Schedule does not permit. The one piece it must not take is the carriageway from Kowloon, classified at 22.3331 between the ring's two lips

The Schedule does not bound Tseung Kwan O New Town; the ring follows the dashed outline on TD's 2005 map, its north edge at 22.333 between Ngan Ying Road (inside) and University Road (outside). The Clear Water Bay Road / New Clear Water Bay Road junction is at 114.2272; the exclusion ring stops at 114.2269 because TD carries the junction's own short links as two-point lines classified at their west end (114.2270)
